cluster_micro

wave_micro_escape_alignment → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale When a fish heading is misaligned with its recorded escape direction, the needed adjustment implies a larger step heading change.

wave_micro_escape_alignment → wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment upward A fish aligned with its escape direction can socially influence neighbors to also align, amplifying the component mean escape alignment beyond simple averaging.
wave_micro_requested_turn_abs → wave_micro_escape_alignment intra_scale Large requested turns can rotate heading toward or away from the recorded escape direction, changing escape alignment.
wave_micro_requested_turn_abs → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Requested turn sets the desired rotation; actual heading change results after turn-rate limits and random perturbation.

wave_micro_requested_turn_abs → wave_meso_component_turn_variance upward Individual requested turn magnitudes are the behavioral inputs that generate within-component variation in requested turns; stronger and more heterogeneous individual turn requests can increase the variance of requested turns across fish in a contact component.

wave_micro_heading_change → wave_micro_requested_turn_abs intra_scale A larger requested turn magnitude is the decision-level driver that produces a larger realized heading change, subject to turning limits.

wave_micro_heading_change → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence upward Individual heading changes are the elementary turns that, when coordinated within a contact component, produce coherent component escape directions.

wave_micro_heading_change → wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment upward Fish that turn toward their escape directions raise the component mean heading-escape alignment; heterogeneous turns weaken that meso alignment.

wave_micro_heading_change → wave_meso_component_turn_variance upward Variation among individual heading changes directly contributes to the spread of requested turn behavior recorded at the component level.
wave_micro_heading_change → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence upward Many small individual turns can collectively synchronize or scatter escape directions, affecting whole-school escape coherence.

wave_meso_component_escape_coherence → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence upward When component members share escape directions, the aggregation across components can raise whole-school escape-direction coherence.
wave_meso_component_escape_coherence → wave_macro_escape_coherence_change upward Changes in component escape coherence propagate to step-to-step changes in school-wide escape-direction coherence.
wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Shared heading-escape alignment can support more coherent escape-direction vectors across component fish.
wave_meso_component_turn_variance → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Heterogeneous requested turns within a component disrupt a shared escape direction and lower coherence.

wave_macro_school_escape_coherence → wave_micro_escape_alignment downward School-level escape coherence acts as a shared directional context that can increase individual heading alignment with own escape direction.
wave_macro_school_escape_coherence → wave_micro_heading_change downward As a coherent escape wave passes, individual fish are plausibly induced to turn, changing step heading-change magnitudes.

wave_macro_school_escape_coherence → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence downward High school-wide escape-direction coherence provides a common directional drive that can increase coherence within contact components.

wave_macro_school_escape_coherence → wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment downward A coherent school escape wave can align component fish headings with their escape directions, plausibly raising component mean alignment.

wave_macro_heading_change_shark_cov → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence downward A strong global covariance between turning and proximity implies coordinated threat response; this can align escape directions inside components and raise component escape coherence.

wave_macro_escape_coherence_change → wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment downward A rising school-wide escape-direction coherence propagates into contact components, making component fish more likely to share a common escape heading and raising component mean heading-escape alignment.
